title: intake
description: Full representation of an intake, returned by the detail endpoint. A superset of `intakeSummary`, adding the received documents and line items.

companyId.description: Id of the company entity that received the document.

source.description: How the document reached Spendesk, or null when not recorded.

supplier.description: The supplier that issued the document. Null when no supplier has been identified yet.

assigneeId.description: Id of the member the intake is assigned to — the person expected to complete and submit it. An id, not a name: resolve it with [Get Users](/reference/v1-get-users), which needs the `user:read` scope in addition to the intake read scope. Null while unassigned.

invoiceNumber.description: The supplier's invoice number as printed on the document. Null if not captured or the document is not an invoice.

creditNoteNumber.description: The supplier's credit-note number as printed on the document. Null if not captured or the document is not a credit note.

currency.description: Currency the document is denominated in. Null until captured, and also null when the captured value is not a three-letter code.

grossAmount.description: Total amount including tax, in `currency`'s smallest unit. Null until captured, and also null, even once captured, whenever `currency` is null or a code Spendesk does not support.

netAmount.description: Total amount before tax, in `currency`'s smallest unit. Null until captured, and also null, even once captured, whenever `currency` is null or a code Spendesk does not support.

netPayableAmount.description: Amount actually left to pay the supplier after deductions recorded on the document (e.g. an advance already paid, or an applied credit note), in `currency`'s smallest unit. Equals `grossAmount` when there are none. Only ever populated for intakes ingested through e-invoicing: it is always null for intakes created through this API and for intakes forwarded by email, where the null is permanent rather than capture-pending.

issueDate.description: Date the supplier issued the document, as printed on it (emission date). Null until captured.

dueDate.description: Date by which the document must be paid, per the supplier's payment terms. Null until captured or when no due date applies.

resultingDocument.description: The document the intake produced or was linked to. Null while the intake is in progress, and stays null for an intake that ends `refused` or `deleted` without producing one. Always null at `status: processed`, which records a controller clearing the to-process queue rather than a document being produced. A null can also mean the lookup failed rather than that none exists, on both List intakes and Get an intake.

payableId.description: Id of the accounting payable the intake ultimately produced, resolvable via the payables API. Null whenever none is known, which is common even at `stage: processed` — that stage also holds refused and deleted intakes, which never produce one. On [List intakes](/reference/v2-list-company-intakes) a null is "unknown" rather than "none"; [Get an intake](/reference/v2-get-company-intake) is authoritative.

purchaseOrderId.description: Id of the purchase order the intake is matched against. Null when none.

correctsIntakeId.description: For a corrective document (e.g. a credit note cancelling or amending an earlier invoice): id of the intake it corrects. Null otherwise.

appUrl.description: Link to this intake in the Spendesk invoice inbox.

createdAt.description: When the intake was received by Spendesk (ingestion time, not `issueDate`).

updatedAt.description: When any field on the intake last changed. Null when never updated.

documents.description: Files received as part of the intake. Empty when no file is available. Download links are short-lived — see `downloadUrl`.

lineItems.description: Lines of the invoice, when any are held. Null when none were extracted or supplied, and always null on receipts and on e-invoiced intakes (`source` `eInvoice`): line items are only held for invoices and credit notes received by email or API, so a null there does not mean the document has no lines. Only the detail endpoint returns these — a full page of them would be too large.

lineItemsSource.description: How the line items were obtained. Null when none are held, or when they predate this field being recorded.

currency.description: If the payment was made in a foreign currency, this amount will be the one in the payment currency. Three-letter [ISO currency codes](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html).
currency.title: currency

date.description: String containing a date expressed in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format like `2023-05-12`.
date.title: date

dateTime.description: String containing a UTC datetime expressed in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format like `2023-05-12T14:06:40Z`.
dateTime.title: dateTime

intakeDocument.description: A file received as part of the intake (the invoice, credit note or receipt itself, or a companion file). Unlike invoice attachments, documents carry no `id` — the underlying storage exposes no stable per-file identifier.

fileName.description: Filename of the document, and the name it saves as when downloaded via `downloadUrl`. This is the original filename when one was captured at ingestion; otherwise a generated identifier with an extension derived from the mime type. Not guaranteed unique within this array.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the file (e.g. `application/pdf`, `application/xml` for e-invoices).

downloadUrl.description: Time-limited pre-signed URL to download the file. Expires at most 3 hours after the response is issued — download promptly and do not persist the URL (re-fetch the intake for a fresh one).

intakeDocument.title: intakeDocument

intakeId.description: Opaque unique identifier of an intake.
intakeId.title: intakeId

intakeLineItem.description: A single line of the invoice. Amounts are decimals in the intake's `currency`, not minor units, because they are transcribed as they appear on the document.

taxRate.description: Tax rate, as a percentage between 0 and 100.

intakeLineItem.title: intakeLineItem

intakeResultingDocument.description: The document the intake produced or was linked to once processing completed. Use `type` to pick the API to resolve `id` against. `invoice` and `creditNote` ids both resolve through the invoice detail endpoint, which returns credit notes with `type` `creditNote`; a `creditNote` id can occasionally return 404 — then list credit notes on the invoices endpoint with `type` `creditNote`.

type.description:
Kind of resulting document. 

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `invoice` | A supplier invoice to pay. |
| `creditNote` | A supplier credit note. |
| `expenseClaim` | An employee expense claim. |
| `cardPayment` | An existing card payment the document was attached to as its receipt. |

intakeResultingDocument.title: intakeResultingDocument

intakeSource.description:
How the document reached Spendesk. 

| Source | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `eInvoice` | Delivered through an e-invoicing network (e.g. Peppol or a French PDP). |
| `email` | Sent or forwarded to the company's invoice inbox email address. |
| `api` | Created programmatically via this API. |
intakeSource.title: intakeSource

intakeStage.description:
Coarse lifecycle stage of the intake, derived from `status`. 

| Stage | Statuses | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inInbox` | `received`, `assigned`, `disputed`, `assignation_rejected`, `supplier_disputed`, `validating` | Awaiting action in the invoice inbox, or submitted and still under review. |
| `linked` | `auto_linked`, `manually_linked` | Done — it was attached to an existing document as its receipt (see `resultingDocument`). |
| `processed` | `validated`, `refused`, `deleted`, `processed` | Terminal — it was refused, deleted, or finished processing (see `resultingDocument`; status `processed` itself never sets one). |
intakeStage.title: intakeStage

intakeStatus.description:
Fine-grained processing status of the intake — the raw underlying status values, exposed verbatim (hence the snake_case). For most integrations the coarser `stage` is easier to work with. 

| Status | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `received` | Landed in the invoice inbox, not yet assigned to a member. |
| `assigned` | Assigned to a member (see `assigneeId`) who must complete and submit it. |
| `supplier_disputed` | The intake was contested with the supplier and awaits their response. |
| `assignation_rejected` | The assignee rejected the assignment; the intake is back in the inbox for reassignment. |
| `disputed` | Legacy predecessor of `assignation_rejected`; may still appear on historical records. |
| `validating` | Submitted and going through review. |
| `validated` | Review complete; about to produce its resulting document. |
| `processed` | Done — a controller cleared it from the to-process queue (e-invoicing only); it does not produce a document, so `resultingDocument` is always null. |
| `auto_linked` | Done — automatically matched and attached to an existing document. |
| `manually_linked` | Done — manually attached to an existing document. |
| `refused` | Rejected by the company; it will not be processed. |
| `deleted` | Removed from the inbox. |

New statuses may be added over time — treat unknown values defensively.
intakeStatus.title: intakeStatus

intakeSupplier.description: The supplier (counterparty) that issued the document, as identified on the intake. `id` and `name` are independently nullable — the object may be present with either field null.

id.description: Supplier id, resolvable via `GET /v1/suppliers/{id}`. Null when the supplier named on the document has not been matched to a supplier record yet.

name.description: Supplier name as identified on the document. Null when no name has been captured yet.

intakeSupplier.title: intakeSupplier

intakeType.description:
Kind of document the intake carries. 

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `invoice` | A supplier invoice: an amount the company owes the supplier for goods or services. |
| `creditNote` | A supplier credit note: a document that reduces an amount owed to the supplier (a refund, cancellation, or correction of a prior invoice). |
| `receipt` | A receipt for a payment already made (e.g. a card payment), to be linked to that payment as documentary evidence. |

Forwarded documents are folded into their base type — a forwarded invoice is `invoice` and a forwarded credit note is `creditNote`; how the document arrived is expressed by `source`.
intakeType.title: intakeType

priceAmount.description:
If the payment was made in a foreign currency, this amount will be the one in the payment currency.
Can contain a negative value in case of refunds.
Expressed in smallest units of the currency (e.g. cents for EUR and USD, but yen for JPY).
priceAmount.title: priceAmount
